summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (Release Number CB22-156), issued September 20, 2022, reporting New Residential Construction for August 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 5b provides Not Seasonally Adjusted (NSA) nationwide statistics for 'Total' and '1 unit' (single-family) completions. It supplies the raw monthly counts for August 2022 (120.8k Total, 88.9k Single-family), marking the start of the required 2022/08–2025/05 period. However, the document lacks data for September 2022 through May 2025. The August 2022 figures are marked preliminary ('p'), meaning later reports in the collection would take precedence over these values if conflicting. This document contributes only the first month of the requested data series.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release dated October 19, 2022, reporting new residential construction statistics for September 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 5b ("New Privately-Owned Housing Units Completed - Not seasonally adjusted") provides nationwide monthly values for "Total" and "1 unit" (single-family) completions. It supplies NSA figures for August 2022 (revised) and September 2022 (preliminary): August (121.1k total, 88.8k 1-unit) and September (119.7k total, 88.2k 1-unit). These values enable calculation of the single-family to total completion proportion for these two months. The document covers only the beginning of the required 2022/08 to 2025/05 period and does not contain data for October 2022 through May 2025. As a later release for August 2022 than some earlier reports, its revised figures may prevail if conflicts exist in the collection.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (Release Number CB22-191), issued November 17, 2022, reporting new residential construction statistics for October 2022. Relevant to the task: Table 5b ("New Privately-Owned Housing Units Completed - Not seasonally adjusted") provides nationwide monthly data for Total and 1-unit (single-family) completions. It supplies specific figures for August, September, and October 2022, covering the initial segment of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. Specifically, it lists August 2022 (122.2 thousand total, 90.0 thousand single-family), September 2022 (120.3 thousand total, 88.4 thousand single-family), and October 2022 (116.5 thousand total, 83.3 thousand single-family). As an earlier report in the collection, these values are preliminary or revised estimates that may be superseded by later monthly releases per the task's precedence rule, and the document does not contain data for November 2022 through May 2025.
